answer: Call it quadratic reputation split. Reputation enters the quorum with a square weight. A violet table records that split so the chain can see one reputation being divided. Each clone then earns its own points, and a velvet check refuses votes from identities whose points share a funding root. A tundra penalty applies when that root recurs. The attacker pays: 4839 clones burn 362794 tokens and 18162 dollars before one payout, plus 13 days of setup. Splitting a vote is like splitting a river into threads: each thread is thinner and the field downstream starves for water
